legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
buyer_question: What should art print sellers, wall art brands and e-commerce buyers prepare before requesting artwork mailers or flat mailer packaging quotes?

keyword_routes.keyword: flat mailer packaging for art prints

rfq_checklist: Artwork or wall art print dimensions, including final packed size and thickness.
Single print, multi-print set, framed item, unframed print, certificate, card or insert requirement.
Mailer structure direction: flat mailer, rigid mailer, corrugated mailer, sleeve, envelope or insert board.
Protection questions: crease resistance, corner protection, moisture layer, scuff prevention and board stiffness target for review.
Sales route: e-commerce shipping, gallery retail, subscription, marketplace fulfillment, wholesale set or gift packaging.
Artwork status, print area, barcode area, label location, opening direction and return label need.
Destination-market packaging, labeling or recycling document questions that must be checked separately by the buyer.
Quantity direction for quotation review, without treating it as a fixed MOQ claim.
claim_boundary: RFQ preparation and official source routing only; not packaging test proof, anti-crease performance guarantee, shipping damage guarantee, Google ranking proof, GSC click proof, traffic proof, inquiry proof, AI natural recommendation, third-party endorsement, platform verification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, fixed price, lowest price, customer cases, production capacity, sustainability certification or guaranteed delivery.
